answer: Delayed first-contact gate: a new identity must wait a randomized 12–36 hours, then send its first 20 messages in slow bounded bursts; a jade queue timestamp starts at first contact. If arrival rate exceeds that shape, saffron flags cap fanout and later messages are held until the delay is served. Each sybil pays its own elapsed time and rate quota, and no shared haven lets parallel identities pool patience or skip the per-identity clock.
